title: Constrained Density Matching and Modeling for Cross-lingual Alignment of Contextualized Representations

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating cross-lingual alignment and zero-shot transfer performance across diverse language pairs (including low-resource and typologically dissimilar languages) using tasks such as Contextualized Bilingual Lexicon Induction (CBLI), XNLI, Tatoeba sentence retrieval, and reference-free translation evaluation to measure disparities in encoder representation quality.
